Compares `fast_poisson`, `fast_binomial`, `fast_gamma` and `fast_nbinomial`
with `jax.random` (or SciPy for the negative binomial, which JAX lacks).
Results come from `run.py`: one speed job each on GPU and CPU, and one
accuracy job on CPU.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import glob
import json
import os
import re
import sys

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

sys.path.append("..")
import checks

DISTS = ["poisson", "binomial", "gamma", "nbinomial"]
TITLES = dict(poisson="Poisson", binomial="Binomial", gamma="Gamma", nbinomial="Negative binomial")
PP, REF = "C0", "C1"
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 9, "axes.titlesize": 9, "legend.fontsize": 7})


def latest(prefix):
    files = glob.glob(os.path.join("results", f"{prefix}_rl*.json"))
    if not files:
        return None
    path = max(files, key=lambda p: int(re.search(r"_rl(\d+)\.json$", p).group(1)))
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)


runs = {"GPU speed": latest("speed_gpu"), "CPU speed": latest("speed_cpu"), "Accuracy": latest("accuracy")}
runs = {k: v for k, v in runs.items() if v is not None}
```

## Runs

```{python}
#| label: versions
#| output: asis
def device(m):
    if m.get("platform") == "gpu":
        return m.get("slurm", {}).get("gpu_type") or ", ".join(m.get("devices", []))
    return m.get("hardware", {}).get("cpu_model") or ", ".join(m.get("devices", []))


table = pd.DataFrame(
    [
        {
            "Run": name,
            "Run level": r["meta"]["run_config"].get("RUN_LEVEL"),
            "pypomp": r["meta"].get("pypomp_version"),
            "JAX": r["meta"].get("jax_version"),
            "Device": device(r["meta"]),
            "Finished (UTC)": r["meta"].get("timestamp", "").replace("T", " ").replace("+00:00", ""),
            "Elapsed (s)": r["meta"].get("elapsed_s"),
            "SLURM job": r["meta"].get("slurm", {}).get("job_id", "—"),
            "quant commit": (r["meta"].get("quant_git_sha") or "—")[:7],
        }
        for name, r in runs.items()
    ]
)
print(table.to_html(index=False, classes="table table-sm", border=0))

versions = {(r["pypomp"], r["JAX"]) for _, r in table.iterrows()}
if len(versions) == 1:
    pp_v, jax_v = versions.pop()
    print(f"\n\n{checks.badge('PASS')} All runs used pypomp {pp_v} and JAX {jax_v}.")
else:
    print(f"\n\n{checks.badge('CHECK')} Runs used different versions, so results may not be comparable.")
```

```{python}
#| label: speed-data
speed = pd.concat(
    [pd.DataFrame(runs[k]["rows"]).assign(platform=k.split()[0]) for k in ("GPU speed", "CPU speed") if k in runs],
    ignore_index=True,
)
speed["ns_per_draw"] = speed["seconds"] / speed["n"] * 1e9
wide = speed.pivot_table(index=["platform", "dist", "regime", "n"], columns="sampler", values="seconds").reset_index()
wide["speedup"] = wide["jax"] / wide["pypomp"]
ORDER = {d: list(dict.fromkeys(g["regime"])) for d, g in speed.groupby("dist", sort=False)}
common = set.intersection(*(set(g["n"]) for _, g in speed.groupby("platform")))
N_REF = max(n for n in common if n <= 10**6)
PLATFORMS = [p for p in ("GPU", "CPU") if p in set(speed["platform"])]


def n_label(n):
    return f"10^{int(round(np.log10(n)))}" if n >= 1000 else str(n)
```

## Headline

```{python}
#| label: headline
#| output: asis
at_ref = wide[(wide["n"] == N_REF) & wide["speedup"].notna()]
head = at_ref.groupby(["dist", "platform"])["speedup"].median().unstack("platform").reindex(DISTS[:3])[PLATFORMS]
head.index = [TITLES[d] for d in head.index]
head.columns.name = None
print(f"Median speedup (JAX time / pypomp time) over parameter regimes at N = {n_label(N_REF)} draws.\n")
print(head.map(lambda v: f"{v:.1f}×").to_html(classes="table table-sm", border=0))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Speed

Each timing is the mean over a JIT-compiled `lax.scan` of batches of N
draws; each batch is summed so that no draw can be optimized away. The
batch count is raised until one timed call lasts at least 0.1 s, and the
fastest of three calls (one, if a call takes over 1 s) is kept. Speedup is JAX time
divided by pypomp time, so values above 1 mean pypomp is faster.

```{python}
#| label: fig-speedup
#| fig-cap: "Speedup of pypomp over JAX against the number of draws N, one line per parameter regime."
fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(PLATFORMS), 3, figsize=(15, 4.2 * len(PLATFORMS)), squeeze=False)
for i, plat in enumerate(PLATFORMS):
    for j, dist in enumerate(DISTS[:3]):
        ax = axes[i, j]
        sub = wide[(wide["platform"] == plat) & (wide["dist"] == dist)]
        for regime in ORDER[dist]:
            g = sub[sub["regime"] == regime]
            ax.plot(g["n"], g["speedup"], marker="o", ms=3, label=regime)
        ax.axhline(1, color="grey", lw=0.8, ls="--")
        ax.set_xscale("log")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.set_title(f"{TITLES[dist]} ({plat})")
        ax.set_xlabel("Draws per batch (N)")
        ax.set_ylabel("Speedup (JAX / pypomp)")
        ax.grid(True, which="both", ls=":", alpha=0.5)
        if i == 0:
            ax.legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

JAX has no negative binomial sampler, so only pypomp's time per draw is shown.

```{python}
#| label: speed-tables

print(f"### Times at N = {n_label(N_REF)}\n")
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")
for dist in DISTS:
    sub = wide[(wide["n"] == N_REF) & (wide["dist"] == dist)]
    cols = {}
    for plat in PLATFORMS:
        s = sub[sub["platform"] == plat].set_index("regime")
        cols[(plat, "pypomp (ms)")] = (s["pypomp"] * 1e3).map("{:.3f}".format)
        if dist != "nbinomial":
            cols[(plat, "JAX (ms)")] = (s["jax"] * 1e3).map("{:.3f}".format)
            cols[(plat, "Speedup")] = s["speedup"].map("{:.1f}×".format)
    tab = pd.DataFrame(cols).reindex(ORDER[dist])
    tab.index.name = "Regime"
    print(f"#### {TITLES[dist]}\n")
    print(tab.to_html(classes="table table-sm", border=0))
    print()
print(":::\n")
```

## Accuracy

```{python}
#| label: accuracy-intro
#| output: asis
acc = runs.get("Accuracy")
N_ACC = acc["meta"]["run_config"]["N_ACC"]
print(
    f"W₁ is the Wasserstein-1 distance between {N_ACC:,} pypomp draws and {N_ACC:,} reference draws "
    "(`jax.random`, or `scipy.stats.nbinom` for the negative binomial). The noise floor is W₁ between "
    "two independent reference samples of the same size. The pypomp line should lie close to the "
    "noise floor. The bottom row divides W₁ by the reference standard deviation."
)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-wasserstein
#| fig-cap: "Wasserstein-1 distance to the reference sampler across parameter values."
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 4, figsize=(17, 7), sharex="col")
for j, dist in enumerate(DISTS):
    w = acc["wasserstein"][dist]
    df = pd.DataFrame(w["rows"])
    fixed = ", ".join(f"{k} = {v}" for k, v in w["fixed"].items())
    for i, scale in enumerate((1.0, df["sd"])):
        ax = axes[i, j]
        ax.plot(df["value"], df["w_pp"] / scale, marker="o", ms=3, color=PP, label="pypomp vs reference")
        ax.plot(df["value"], df["w_ref"] / scale, marker="s", ms=3, ls="--", color=REF, label="noise floor")
        if dist in ("poisson", "gamma"):
            ax.set_xscale("log")
        ax.grid(True, ls=":", alpha=0.5)
        ax.set_ylabel("W₁" if i == 0 else "W₁ / sd")
        if i == 0:
            ax.set_title(TITLES[dist] + (f" ({fixed})" if fixed else ""))
        else:
            ax.set_xlabel(w["param"])
axes[0, 0].legend()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: miss-intro
#| output: asis
mr = acc["miss_rates"]
print(
    f"Miss rate is the fraction of {mr['n_queries']:,} uniform queries u ∈ [0.0001, 0.9999] for which "
    "`poissoninv` or `binominv` differs from SciPy's exact quantile. A rate of zero is drawn as an open "
    "marker at half the resolution, 1 / (2 × queries)."
)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-miss-rates
#| fig-cap: "Quantile miss rates of the approximate inverse CDFs."
floor = 0.5 / mr["n_queries"]


def miss_line(ax, x, rate, color, label):
    rate = np.asarray(rate)
    ax.plot(x, np.where(rate > 0, rate, floor), color=color, lw=1.5, label=label)
    ax.scatter(np.asarray(x)[rate > 0], rate[rate > 0], color=color, s=18, zorder=3)
    ax.scatter(np.asarray(x)[rate == 0], np.full((rate == 0).sum(), floor), facecolors="none",
               edgecolors=color, s=18, zorder=3)


fig, (a1, a2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.2))
pois = pd.DataFrame(mr["poisson"])
miss_line(a1, pois["lam"], pois["rate"], PP, None)
a1.set_xscale("log")
a1.set_xlabel("λ")
a1.set_title("poissoninv")
binom = pd.DataFrame(mr["binomial"])
for c, (n, g) in enumerate(binom.groupby("n")):
    miss_line(a2, g["p"], g["rate"], f"C{c}", f"n = {n}")
a2.set_xlabel("p")
a2.set_title("binominv")
a2.legend()
for ax in (a1, a2):
    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.set_ylabel("Miss rate")
    ax.axhline(floor, color="grey", lw=0.6, ls=":")
    ax.grid(True, which="both", ls=":", alpha=0.5)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Distributions

```{python}
#| label: dist-plot-utils
QQ_P = np.asarray(acc["qq_probs"])
QQ_KEEP = np.minimum(QQ_P, 1 - QQ_P) >= 0.999 * 10 / N_ACC
QQ_TAIL = np.minimum(QQ_P, 1 - QQ_P)[QQ_KEEP].min()
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
```

```{python}
#| label: dist-intro
#| output: asis
print(
    f"Each panel compares {N_ACC:,} pypomp draws with {N_ACC:,} `jax.random` draws, or with the exact "
    "SciPy distribution for the negative binomial. Densities should overlap, and Q-Q points should lie "
    f"on y = x. Q-Q plots use {QQ_KEEP.sum()} quantiles down to tail probability {QQ_TAIL:.0e}, "
    "where at least 10 draws are expected beyond the quantile. Discrete Q-Q points get "
    "N(0, 0.1²) jitter so that coincident points stay visible. Gamma with α < 0.1 is shown on a log₁₀ scale."
)
```

```{python}
#| label: dist-plot-fns

def grid(panels, ncols):
    nrows = -(-len(panels) // ncols)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(2.4 * ncols, 2.0 * nrows), squeeze=False)
    for ax in axes.ravel()[len(panels):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return fig, axes.ravel()


def density(dist, ncols, ref_label):
    panels = acc["distributions"][dist]
    fig, axes = grid(panels, ncols)
    for ax, p in zip(axes, panels):
        if "edges" in p:
            e = np.asarray(p["edges"])
            ax.stairs(p["ref"], e, color=REF, lw=1.5, label=ref_label)
            ax.stairs(p["pp"], e, color=PP, lw=1.2, ls="--", label="pypomp")
            if p["log10"]:
                ax.set_xlabel("log₁₀ value", fontsize=7)
        else:
            x, pp, ref = np.asarray(p["x"]), np.asarray(p["pp"]), np.asarray(p["ref"])
            keep = np.flatnonzero(np.maximum(pp, ref) > 1e-5)
            sl = slice(keep.min(), keep.max() + 1)
            ax.step(x[sl], ref[sl], where="mid", color=REF, lw=1.5, label=ref_label)
            ax.step(x[sl], pp[sl], where="mid", color=PP, lw=1.2, ls="--", label="pypomp")
        ax.set_title(p["label"])
        ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
    axes[0].legend()
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()


def qq(dist, ncols, ref_label):
    panels = acc["distributions"][dist]
    fig, axes = grid(panels, ncols)
    for k, (ax, p) in enumerate(zip(axes, panels)):
        x, y = np.asarray(p["ref_q"])[QQ_KEEP], np.asarray(p["pp_q"])[QQ_KEEP]
        if "edges" not in p:
            x = x + rng.normal(0, 0.1, x.size)
            y = y + rng.normal(0, 0.1, y.size)
        ax.scatter(x, y, s=4, alpha=0.4, color=PP)
        lim = [min(x.min(), y.min()), max(x.max(), y.max())]
        ax.plot(lim, lim, color="red", ls="--", lw=1)
        ax.set_title(p["label"])
        ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)
        if k % ncols == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("pypomp quantiles", fontsize=7)
        if k >= len(panels) - ncols:
            ax.set_xlabel(f"{ref_label} quantiles", fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```
